beats.text: Six skills that will take you further than any degree.
One. Writing clearly. Clear writing is just clear thinking made visible.
Two. Speaking so people actually listen. Ideas don't spread themselves.
Three. Selling — a product, a vision, yourself. Every career runs on it.
Four. Managing your own attention, in a world built to steal it.
Five. Learning how to learn — so no new skill is ever out of reach.
Six. Staying calm under pressure, when everyone around you is losing their head.
No exam grades these. But master a few, and doors open that no diploma can.
